description: Use when writing app, backend or API-key integration code for the Didit client SDKs in web and mobile apps. Use when the user wants to launch a Didit verification session in a web page (redirect, iframe, or the JavaScript SDK @didit-protocol/sdk-web), an iOS app (DiditSDK, Swift), an Android app (me.didit:didit-sdk, Kotlin), a React Native or Expo app (@didit-protocol/sdk-react-native) or a Flutter app (didit_sdk); create the session on a backend and hand the url or session_token to the client; handle SDK results, callbacks and errors; submit monitored transactions from the device with a transaction SDK token (submitTransaction, wallet ownership, step-up verification); or send monitoring events from a device with a monitoring token. Keeps the API key on the backend. Also use for any combination of Identity verification, Transaction monitoring and end-user Authentication, checking release availability first.
